accessibilityNotes: Keyboard order follows timeline, topology, run inspector, freshness/RBAC, and support handoff regions.
Screen reader labels announce projection source, freshness, tenant/RBAC disposition, proof mode, and safe action.
Color is never the only signal.
Motion is optional and respects reduced-motion preferences.
scopeOut: No projection runtime, read store, GraphQL facade, or subscription service.
